### Laozi on way

Laozi (traditionally 6th century BCE) approaches way within Daoism. The Dao is the nameless generative way from which the ten thousand things arise; naming and forcing distort it. Wu wei recommends non-coercive, timely action that does not strain against the grain of things. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets way most directly—useful for searches such as “laozi quotes on way.”
